'''May 2001 Pleasanton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Pleasanton, California on 19 May 2001. [[Steve Daniel]] won it. It is known from Kyle Ishimaru's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2347">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-21-5-19-01-pleasanton-ca-why-2-is-goodd2347/ 5-19-01-pleasanton-ca-why-2-is-good], DeckTech (Kyle "Psyokid" Ishimaru, 21 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-21-5-19-01-pleasanton-ca-why-2-is-goodd2347/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 20
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Daniel]]
